reference.csv.purpose: Reserved true outcome and observed rows; never generator-visible

design_spine.csv.purpose: All positive-weight fasting-subsample design records; retain out-of-domain records in Taylor variance estimation. row_id is populated only in domain.

linkage_private.csv.purpose: Custodian-only identity linkage, unnecessary for evaluator scientific analysis

survey_guidance.method: Use a survey-aware domain estimator, preserving the complete positive-weight design spine. No weight rescaling for a single two-year cycle.

blinding: Parent receives counts and integrity hashes only until evaluation is authorized. Generator receives shared files only. Evaluator may receive reference and design spine after generation/evaluation protocol freeze.
